name: Changle

queries.query: Changle Fujian China official cadastral parcel map real estate registration GIS
queries.result: Found the official Changle District government site, an official notice naming the district real-estate registration and trading center and its announced transaction-information platform, and the official Fujian Natural Resources portal for Tianditu Fujian. No anonymous parcel feature endpoint or safe polygon response was verified.

queries.result: Found the official Changle District Natural Resources and Planning Bureau page stating that it is responsible for unified natural-resource and real-estate title registration, cadastral surveys, and basic surveying; the district government notice identifies the district real-estate registration and trading center. No public anonymous parcel ID+geometry response was verified.

registryEvidence.basis: The official Changle District Natural Resources and Planning Bureau page assigns the district responsibility for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral surveys, and basic surveying. The official district notice is issued by the Changle District Real Estate Registration and Trading Center and names that local custodian's platform.

officialSources.observation: First-party district bureau page states responsibility for unified real-estate registration, cadastral surveys, archives, and basic surveying across Changle District.
First-party district notice from the Real Estate Registration and Trading Center announces its platform URL change to http://124.72.21.193:8090/sd_web/ effective 2020-09-21.

First-party Fujian Natural Resources article links the public Tianditu Fujian map at https://fujian.tianditu.gov.cn/map and describes it as a public geographic-information sharing service; it does not document parcel-layer schema.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Changle District local registration custodian and Fujian provincial public geographic-information routes described by first-party sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous city-bounded parcel feature response was retrieved; no CRS, schema, native parcel identity, or safe polygon sample was available.

remainingUncertainty: The announced district platform may be legacy, and the Fujian Tianditu viewer may expose routes only through its current client or network path. The observed timeouts are not evidence of citywide parcel absence. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or owner/address/contact/titleholder/personal/tax/account fields were used.
